thread:
Morgan (eng-infra): Kicking off nodepool commissioning for Acadia (EMEA) private cluster — air-gapped VPC. Goal: provision 4x A100 GPUs, 3 control-plane nodes, nodepool autoscale, and handoff doc. Target go-live: Fri EOD. @Neha @Sam please validate capacity/costs.
Neha (eng-ml): Noted. 4x A100 should cover initial throughput for the embed+chat workloads but we should plan headroom for peak batch evals. Can we reserve 20% spare GPU budget for the first 2 weeks?
Sam (eng-ops): 20% reserve ok. Need CIDR & transit details from network team. Also confirm airgap image delivery method (USB vs signed artifacts on bastion).
Alejandro (solutions): Customer prefers signed artifact delivery over physical media. They have an approved jump-host reachable from our delivery engineer. Requirements: SHA256 signed images, KMS key ARN provided, and offline pull repo.
Shreya (security): We'll need SBOM for any runtime images and attestations for HSM key usage. Also enforce node-level disk encryption.
Morgan (eng-infra): Draft runbook below — please review and call out gaps. TL;DR steps: 1) Pre-provision VPC/CIDR 2) Seed OS + kubelet images (signed) 3) Provision control-plane (3 nodes) 4) Commission GPU nodepool (4 A100, taints/tolerations) 5) Run validation suites 6) Handoff checklist.
Sam (eng-ops): When you say "seed images" include: base-ami.tar, kubelet.tar, runc, and our runtime pkgs. We should use our airgap image format: image-YYYYMMDD.tar.gz + .sig
Morgan (eng-infra): Exactly. Example commands for signing: 
```
# on build host
sha256sum image-20260318.tar.gz > image.sha256
kms sign --key-id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd --digest-file image.sha256 --out image.sig
```
Neha (eng-ml): For the GPU nodepool config: recommend NVIDIA driver pinned to 525.x, CUDA 11.8, and containerd with gpu-device-plugin. Also set GPU memory overcommit to 0.9 for noncritical workloads.
Alejandro (solutions): Nodepool instance type: 4x A100-80GB would be ideal but region limits in eu-west-1 are tight. Proposed fallback: 4x A100-40GB (p4d variant). Sam, can procurement request quota bump?
Sam (eng-ops): I'll open quota ticket now. ETA 48-72h for GPUs. We should prepare fallback AMI + smaller batch size config. Also note cost estimate: A100-80GB ~ $12/hr each proforma -> monthly ~ $34k with 24/7; include reserved commit options.
Shreya (security): Network constraints: customer requires no egress to public internet. We must set up private registry mirror inside their VPC and route only to the jump-host for delivery. Also confirm TLS certs and rotation plan.
k8s-deploy-bot: seed-image: pushed image-20260318.tar.gz to /opt/airgap/stage on delivery-bastion (checksum: 9f2b...); status: awaiting signature verification.
Morgan (eng-infra): Validation checklist (run after nodepool created):
- kubectl get nodes -> control-plane Ready (3)
- kubectl get nodes -l nodepool=acadia-gpu -> 4 Ready
- nvidia-smi on each GPU node -> report match with expected driver (525.x)
- run small perf test: 10 concurrent inference streams, p99 < 120ms
- run disk encryption verification: dm-crypt active
- pull-from-local-registry test -> container image pulls succeed from mirror
- KV cache sanity: start mock workload, verify cache hit rate > 60% for 90s window
Neha (eng-ml): Add model loading smoke: load the resizable LLM runtime, run a 2-token step to ensure KV cache warming doesn't OOM.
Sam (eng-ops): Also include autoscaler smoke: scale from 1->4 pods during load test and ensure nodes spin up in <4 minutes. If slower, tune kubelet/systemd timeouts.
Alejandro (solutions): Handoff items for customer success: runbook PDF, ops playbook (inc. commands to rotate images, add nodepool), cost run-rate sheet, and escalation path (oncall list + SRE pager).
Shreya (security): Final acceptance gates before handoff: audit logs sent to customer's SIEM, KMS integration validated, image sigs verified, and RBAC constrained to allowed principals.
Morgan (eng-infra): Delivery timeline/owners: 
- Sam: quota & fallback AMI (today)
- Neha: GPU config + perf targets (tomorrow)
- Alejandro: delivery coordinate with customer jump-host (today)
- Shreya: security audit checklist (tomorrow)
I'll be doing the commissioning run at 09:00 UTC Friday.
Sam (eng-ops): Noted. I'll create the quota ticket #Q-7892 and attach the fallback AMI.
Alejandro (solutions): I'll send the signed-image transfer instructions to customer Ops and include checksum + KMS key ARN.
Neha (eng-ml): I'll prepare a small perf job YAML: 
```
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata: { name: llm-smoke }
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: smoke
        image: local.registry/acadia/llm-smoke:20260318
        resources:
          limits: { nvidia.com/gpu: 1 }
      restartPolicy: Never
```
Shreya (security): One more: enforce node-level auditd with forwarder to their SIEM. I'll share a config snippet.
k8s-deploy-bot: control-plane bootstrap completed: 3 nodes registered, etcd cluster stable.
Morgan (eng-infra): Great. Before I start Friday, final signoff? Reply with :thumbsup: when you confirm your action items done.
Neha (eng-ml): :thumbsup: I'll be available during the run for perf troubleshooting.
Sam (eng-ops): :thumbsup: Quota ticket filed and fallback AMI uploaded.
Alejandro (solutions): :thumbsup: Delivery instructions sent to customer.
Shreya (security): :thumbsup: Audit & KMS checks scheduled.
Morgan (eng-infra): Awesome — running the commissioning playbook Friday 09:00 UTC. Will post a short summary + any blockers in this thread after the run. Thanks all.
